criteria.requirement: Add JSONConfigFileParser as a ConfigFileParser accepting object roots, finite JSON scalars and flat scalar lists. Normalize bool to true/false and other scalar values to strings for the existing actual ArgumentParser action pipeline. Reject null, nested objects/lists, non-object roots, invalid JSON/encoding and NaN/Infinity. duplicates defaults to error and supports last/warn explicitly; never include values in duplicate diagnostics. Serialize supported values to Unicode-preserving valid JSON with roundtrip behavior; optional YAML must not be imported.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
